measurement.method: UNODC typical retail value, with a midpoint fallback for a complete range; multiple reports and reviewed source forms are averaged at country, drug and year grain
measurement.unit: nominal USD per gram; purity in percent where reported

provenance.publisher: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime
provenance.title: World Drug Report 2026, Statistical Annex 8.1: Prices and purities of drugs

limitations: Country and drug reporting is incomplete across years; absent rows are unavailable, and no missing year is interpolated.
Pakistan has no matching retail per-gram observations in this retained edition; this is not evidence of a zero price or absent drug market.
This legacy four-drug summary pools reviewed forms and reports; use the global drugs dataset for separate source entries and original units.
WDR data reproduction is limited to educational and non-profit use with attribution; commercial reuse requires prior written UNODC permission.
Prices are nominal reported retail values, not market-size, availability or transaction-volume estimates.
Cross-country price comparisons require exchange-rate, purchasing-power, purity and reporting-context caveats.

measurement.method: Target-geography matches in audited INCB statements, retaining source wording, bounds, record kinds and paragraph locators
measurement.unit: reported kilograms or qualified bounds; qualitative operation records remain non-summable
measurement.grain: source statement and named geography role

quantityAggregation.reason: The retained records include bounds, different precursor bases and different geographic roles.

corridors.quantityBasis: Combined substance mass across nine PICS incidents; the source reports nearly 5 tons, retained as a less-than 5,000 kg bound.
Derived upper bound for the amount seized in Thailand: two thirds of a six-seizure aggregate reported as less than 1,500 kg of substance.

contextRecords.summary: INCB reports that four participating countries recorded 168 seizures during Operation Pseudonym, most in Australia and New Zealand, and that origins for substances in both countries were reported as China and India. The report does not allocate seizure count or mass by origin-and-destination pair.

limitations: A geography match is not proof of a bilateral route between target countries.
The Myanmar record reports Myanmar as destination and explicitly leaves origin unreported; it is not a China-Myanmar flow.
Operation Pseudonym names China and India as reported origins but does not allocate count or mass by origin-destination pair.
The records are selected reported incidents, not a complete flow series or an estimate of successful movement.

measurement.method: Count of OFAC SDN records carrying each target country as a country of record and a retained narcotics or TCO program; subject fields removed
measurement.grain: country of record and program family

provenance.publisher: US Department of the Treasury, Office of Foreign Assets Control
provenance.title: US Treasury OFAC - Specially Designated Nationals List

limitations: A designation is a published government action, not an adjudication of guilt or independent proof of described conduct.
Country of record comes from the retained OFAC address geography and is not a nationality finding.
No matching rows means only that this scoped snapshot produced none; it is not a claim that no relevant actor or action exists.
No subject name, alias, identifier or address crosses this bridge.

measurement.method: CITES confiscation-record counts where a target country appears in the retained exporter or importer ranking
measurement.grain: country role in retained top-country table

provenance.publisher: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora
provenance.title: CITES Trade Database - confiscation records (Source = I)

limitations: Not in the retained top table is an unavailable value, never zero.
Exporter and importer record counts can overlap and must not be added.
CITES quantities mix incompatible units, so the bridge counts records and never sums physical quantities.
Coverage is limited to listed species and depends on party reporting and enforcement.

exclusions.reason: Regional flow volumes, the meth activity index and country-to-region precursor inflows are not official observations.
Conflict-event data has separate licensing and claim semantics and does not enter this official drug-market bridge.
No political party, civil-society movement, armed organization or community is classified through aggregate drug-market data.
Names, aliases, identifiers and addresses do not cross the aggregate boundary.
The bridge carries no navigable coordinates, operational vulnerabilities, synthesis routes, yields or procurement guidance.

limitations: This is a deterministic country-level evidence overlay, not a risk score, relationship graph or live feed.
A shared geography or period does not establish that two datasets describe the same event, actor or causal chain.
Official source status describes provenance and does not make a source complete or convert an allegation into a finding.
Palimpsest must byte-pin and review a changed artifact before using it in a public claim.
